data.name: Shakti
data.gender_notes: Shakti is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The divine feminine power, the primal creative force in the universe, the mother of the universe. The name Shakti carries the meaning “Power, Energy, Fertility” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shakti usually hope their child will grow to embody power, energy, fertility and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The embodiment of divine feminine energy and creativity, the source of all life and power.
data.etymology: Shakti belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Power, Energy, Fertility.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shakti total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_sanskrit.name: शक्ति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शक्ति (śakti) in Sanskrit refers to power, energy, or strength. It is often personified as a goddess representing the divine feminine and cosmic creative energy. The term is also used to describe the inherent power in all beings and things.

in_hindi.name: शक्ति
in_hindi.meaning: शक्ति (śakti) in Hindi is the same as in Sanskrit and holds the same meaning. It is a common name for girls in India and is used to signify power, strength, and energy.

in_tamil.name: சக்தி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name for Shakti is சக்தி (cakti). It is derived from the Sanskrit word शक्ति (śakti). In Tamil, the name can be translated as 'usefulness' or 'effectiveness', represented by the words அவசர்த்திரம் (avasarthiram) or அவசாரம் (avasāram).

in_telugu.name: శక్తి
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name for Shakti is శక్తి (śakti). It is derived from the Sanskrit word शक्ति (śakti) and holds the same meaning. It is a common name for girls in Telugu-speaking communities and is used to signify power, strength, and energy.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shakti holds immense cultural significance in Hinduism, representing the dynamic, creative, and transformative power of the female deity. Shakti is often depicted as the consort of various popular Hindu gods, including Shiva and Vishnu, and is considered to be the goddess of power, energy, and strength.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, Shakti is regarded as the primal creative force and the source of all divine energy in the universe. She is often considered to be the embodiment of divine feminine power, which is essential for sustaining the cycle of creation, preservation, and destruction.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shakti represents divine feminine power and energy in the universe, the creative force that drives all manifestation and transformation. It is the divine consort of Shiva, symbolizing strength, courage, and the dynamic aspect of the divine.

name_in_real_life.story: Devi Shakti from Kathmandu, Nepal embodies the meaning of Shakti - "Power, Energy, Fertility". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
